categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business segments include conventional architectural design services, emerging business design and consulting, EPC (Engineering-Procurement-Construction) total contracting, construction drawing review services, engineering quality testing services, and contract energy management. These services are organized across multiple internal design institutes and research centers, with extensions into related consulting and technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs comprehensive architectural design methodologies including scheme design, preliminary design, and construction drawing design. Core technologies include BIM (Building Information Modeling) technology, AI-assisted design, digital twin visualization, prefabricated building design systems, green building design standards, and energy-efficient building technologies. The company utilizes CAD and specialized design software, along with advanced technical analysis methods for structural, mechanical, and environmental systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government agencies, real estate developers, state-owned enterprises, and institutional clients requiring architectural and engineering services. Key end markets include public buildings (education, healthcare, cultural facilities), residential developments, municipal infrastructure, industrial facilities, and urban renewal projects. The company serves clients across government procurement, commercial real estate, and infrastructure development sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Hefei, Anhui Province and primarily operates within Anhui Province, which accounts for approximately 94.71% of revenue. However, the company has expanded to over 20 provinces and municipalities including Shanghai, Hainan, Chongqing, Hubei, Guangxi, Shandong, and Beijing through subsidiary operations and regional offices.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the construction value chain. It provides design and consulting services that bridge the planning and construction phases, and extends downstream through EPC contracting, construction drawing review, quality testing, and energy management services. The company functions as a service provider to construction projects rather than as a material or equipment supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include digital transformation through BIM and AI technology application, green and low-carbon building design, prefabricated building systems, energy efficiency and carbon reduction technologies, urban renewal and historic preservation, and full-process engineering consulting. R&D focuses on zero-carbon buildings, building-integrated photovoltaics, smart building systems, and advanced construction methodologies aligned with national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through professional service fees for architectural design and consulting work. Revenue streams include design service fees (conventional and emerging business design), EPC contracting fees, construction drawing review fees, engineering quality testing fees, and contract energy management service fees. Revenue is recognized upon completion of design phases and delivery of services to clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with large national design enterprises leveraging superior resources and nationwide networks, international design firms with advanced design concepts and technologies, medium-sized specialized design firms focusing on niche markets, and construction enterprises entering the design services market. The company maintains a leading position in Anhui Province's architectural design industry but faces intensifying competition from larger national firms and international competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of 354.07 million yuan, representing a 31.15% decline from 2023's 514.23 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 15.57 million yuan, down 73.90% year-over-year. The company has experienced significant contraction in 2024 following previous growth, with declining profitability and compressed margins reflecting industry-wide challenges in the architectural design sector.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through comprehensive integrated design services spanning multiple disciplines, specialized expertise in emerging areas (green buildings, prefabricated construction, energy management), advanced technology application (BIM, AI, digital twins), quality design outcomes recognized through numerous industry awards (645 cumulative design awards), and full-process consulting capabilities. The company emphasizes sustainable design, innovation in construction methodologies, and comprehensive solutions addressing client needs across project lifecycles.
